films.title: Burning Betrayal
films.overview: Babi discovers a betrayal by her long-term partner and decides to embark on a new adventure in life. On this journey, she meets judge Marco and they begin to live a story permeated by a lot of sexual tension.

films.title: Beyond the Universe
films.overview: While waiting for a kidney transplant, a young pianist finds an unexpected connection with her doctor — and the courage to fulfill her musical dreams.

films.title: Caramelo
films.overview: After a life-changing diagnosis, a promising chef finds hope and humor with the help of a fur-midable dog friend.
